profile.headline: Business Intelligence | Data Visualization | Data Modeling
profile.summary:
Highly motivated experienced IT professional with a background in analyzing, designing, developing and supporting business intelligence applications while providing business solutions to stakeholders. Excellent communication and problem-solving skills with the ability to clearly define projects, objectives, goals, schedules and assignments.  
Experience with a variety of BI tools, e.g., Oracle, Tableau, Power BI

Specialties : Power BI, Tableau, OBIEE, SSRS,.
Database Skills: Oracle SQL, SQL Server, PL/SQL

Fluent in Spanish and English.
